hooks.command: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false; $claudeConfig = if ($env:CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR) { $env:CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR } else { Join-Path $HOME '.claude' }; $candidates = @(); if ($env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT) { $candidates += $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT }; if ($env:PLUGIN_ROOT) { $candidates += $env:PLUGIN_ROOT }; $cacheRoot = Join-Path $claudeConfig 'plugins\cache\thedotmack\claude-mem'; if (Test-Path $cacheRoot) { $candidates += Get-ChildItem -Path $cacheRoot -Directory | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName } }; $candidates += Join-Path $claudeConfig 'plugins\marketplaces\thedotmack\plugin'; $pluginRoot = $null; foreach ($candidate in $candidates) { if (-not $candidate) { continue }; $root = if (Test-Path (Join-Path $candidate 'plugin\scripts')) { Join-Path $candidate 'plugin' } else { $candidate }; if (Test-Path (Join-Path $root 'scripts\version-check.js')) { $pluginRoot = $root; break } }; if (-not $pluginRoot) { Write-Error 'claude-mem: version-check.js not found'; exit 1 }; $versionCheck = Join-Path $pluginRoot 'scripts\version-check.js'; & node $versionCheck; exit $LASTEXITCODE
